name: Projected & Casement Windows
description: Kawneer aluminum windows are designed to increase daylighting, ventilation and provide quality views to the outside while providing high thermal performance and energy efficiency. The range of Kawneer windows allow you to have increase design flexibility, thermal options and offer more aesthetic choices for new and retrofit construction. Kawneer Projected & Casement Windows featuring: OptiQ™ AA™4325 Series Windows, TR-700 - Window Wall, 8225TL Thermal Windows, TR-2000 Series Windows, TR-3000 Series Windows, 526 Thermal Windows, AA™6400 Thermal Windows, NX-200 Series Windows, NX-300 Series Windows, NX-4000, NX-3000, and AA™900 Thermal Windows A projected window is a window consisting of one of more sash hinged at the top or bottom which project inward or outward from the plane of the window. A casement window is a window consisting of one or more sash hinged to open from the side which project outward or inward from the plane of the window in the vertical plane. Thermal performance is a key attribute of Kawneer windows which helps to reduce energy demands. Kawneer windows are thermally broken to improve thermal resistance. Thermal barriers are created using two methods: insertion of low conductance material and poured polymers. TM AA 900 PROJECT-OUT THERMAL WINDOW Performance Standards Kawneer products are tested, certified and labeled for the following performance standards: AAMA/WDMA/CSA 101/IS2/A440 (NAFS-North American Fenestration Standard/Specification for windows, doors, and skylights) for the most current version ASTM E283, AAMA 501 and NFRC 400 Air Leakage ASTME331 and AAMA 501 Water Penetration ASTME330 and AAMA 501 Static Structural Performance AAMA 1503, AAMA 507 and NFRC 100 Thermal Transmittance - U-Factors AAMA 1503, CSA A440.2 and NFRC 500 Condensation Resistance (CRF,I,CR) AAMA 507 and NFRC 200 Overall Solar Heat Gain Coefficient and Visible Transmittance (SHGC) & (VT) AAMA 1801, ASTM E90 and ASTM E1425 Sound Transmission (STC, OITC) ©2015 UL LLC.
